rules.title: Structured query keys
rules.text: Use structured query keys from a central factory and include every input that affects the result.

rules.title: Invalidate after mutation
rules.text: Invalidate or update affected queries after a mutation.

rules.title: Do not copy into state
rules.text: Do not copy query data into local state; read it from the query.

rules.title: Tune staleTime
rules.text: Set staleTime deliberately per query instead of relying on defaults.

rules.title: Handle all states
rules.text: Render loading, error and empty states for every query.
